{"status":"available","text":"任务、输入与输出。论文处理的是静态场景多视角照片的新视角合成：输入是一组图像以及由 SfM 标定的对应相机，SfM 过程附带产生的稀疏点云被直接用来初始化 3D Gaussians，最终输出是一组无结构、显式的 3D Gaussians（E007, E013），在若干已发表数据集上可做到 1080p 分辨率的实时渲染（E002）。其方法由三部分组成：作为辐射场表示的各向异性 3D Gaussians、与 adaptive density control 交替进行的 3D Gaussian 属性优化、以及为 GPU 设计的快速可微渲染方案（E008, E009, E010）。与多数需要 MVS 数据的点基方法不同，本方法只用 SfM 点即可取得高质量结果；在 NeRF-synthetic 数据集上甚至可以从随机初始化开始（E007）。

场景表示。每个 3D Gaussian 由中心（mean）μ、定义在世界空间的全 3D covariance matrix Σ 与不透明度 α 刻画，其在空间中的权重写作 G(x) = e^{−1/2 (x−μ)^T Σ^{−1} (x−μ)}（式 4）：指数中的二次型随位置 x 偏离中心 μ 而衰减，Σ 决定这个各向异性椭球的形状，α 则在 blending 过程中与该 Gaussian 相乘（E018, E021, E022）。选择 Gaussian 的理由是它既可微、又是无结构且显式的基元，可以投影成 2D splats 做快速 α-blending，从而同时具备可微体积表示与显式表示的优点（E015）。方向性的外观（颜色）由 spherical harmonics (SH) 系数表示，使每个 Gaussian 的颜色能够随视角变化（E013）。

渲染时的投影。给定 viewing transformation W，相机坐标下的 covariance matrix 为 Σ' = J W Σ W^T J^T（式 5），其中 J 是投影变换仿射近似的 Jacobian，式中的 W、J 与 Σ 之间均为矩阵乘法（E027, E028）。去掉 Σ' 的第三行与第三列后得到 2×2 variance matrix，其结构与性质同从带法线的平面点出发所得一致（E029）。

可优化参数化。直接对 Σ 做梯度下降无法保证其半正定，更新步很容易产生非法 covariance matrix（E030）。因此改用 Σ = R S S^T R^T（式 6）：3D Gaussian 的 covariance matrix 相当于描述一个椭球的构型，scaling matrix S 决定椭球各轴的长度与比例，rotation matrix R 决定其朝向；两者分别以 3D 向量 s 与四元数 q 存储以便独立优化，其中 q 在使用前需归一化为单位四元数（E031, E033, E034）。这种各向异性参数化使 Gaussian 能贴合被捕获场景中不同形状的几何，得到相当紧凑的表示（E036）。

梯度。为避免训练时自动微分带来的显著开销，所有参数的梯度都被显式推导（E035）。推导经由 M = RS 与 Σ = M M^T 的分解，由于 covariance matrix 及其梯度都是对称的，链式法则中共享的前一段可以一次算出，再分别对 s 与 q 求导；四元数归一化部分的梯度为常规推导（E203, E207, E231）。

优化流程、初始化与损失。优化由反复的渲染并与训练视图比较来驱动；由于 3D 到 2D 投影存在歧义，几何可能被放错位置，因此优化既需要创建几何，也需要销毁或移动放错的几何（E055）。参与优化的参数是位置 p、α、covariance Σ 以及表示颜色的 SH 系数 c；初始 covariance 取 isotropic Gaussian，其轴长等于到最近三个点距离的均值（E038, E058）。α 经 sigmoid 激活被约束在 [0−1) 区间以获得平滑梯度，covariance 的 scale 使用 exponential activation，位置则采用类似 Plenoxels 的 exponential decay scheduling（E057, E058）。损失为 L = (1−λ)L1 + λ L_D-SSIM，所有测试取 λ = 0.2（E059, E060）。Algorithm 1 给出的循环是：采样训练视图 V 与图像，经光栅化得到 I，计算损失后用 Adam 反向传播并更新位置、covariance、颜色与不透明度（E236, E237, E238, E239）。

自适应密度控制。优化 warm-up 之后每 100 iterations 做一次 densify，同时剔除 α 低于阈值 ε_α 的近似透明 Gaussians（E063）。增密针对两类区域：欠重建与过重建，二者都表现出较大的 view-space positional gradients，因此把 view-space 位置梯度平均幅度超过 τ_pos = 0.0002 的 Gaussians 作为候选（E064, E065）。欠重建区域内的小 Gaussian 采用 clone：复制一个同尺寸副本并沿位置梯度方向移动，因而同时增大系统总体积与 Gaussian 数量（E066, E068）。过重建区域（高方差）的大 Gaussian 采用 split：替换为两个新 Gaussian，scale 除以实验确定的 φ = 1.6，新位置以原 3D Gaussian 作为 PDF 采样，从而保持总体积而增加数量（E067, E068）。为抑制靠近输入相机的 floaters 造成的密度虚增，每 N = 3000 iterations 把 α 置为接近零，再由优化只在需要处提升 α、由剔除去掉 α 小于 ε_α 者；同时周期性移除 worldspace 中过大或 viewspace footprint 过大的 Gaussians（E068, E079）。

快速可微 rasterizer。目标是整体渲染与排序都快、支持各向异性 splats 的近似 α-blending，并且不设前作那种可接收梯度的 splat 数量的硬上限（E081）。流程为：把屏幕切成 16×16 tiles 并先做视锥体裁剪，只保留 99% 置信区间与视锥相交的 Gaussians，对均值贴近近平面、远在视锥之外的极端个体用 guard band 直接拒绝，因为其投影 2D covariance 不稳定（E083）。随后按每个 Gaussian 覆盖的 tile 数实例化，为每个实例分配由 view space depth 与 tile ID 组合的 key，用单次 GPU Radix sort 全局排序；由于不做额外的逐像素排序，blending 直接建立在这一初始排序之上，在某些配置下是近似的，但当 splat 接近单像素大小时这些近似可忽略（E085, E242）。排序后由同一 tile 内首末 depth-sorted entry 得到 per-tile 列表；光栅化时每个 tile 启动一个 thread block，协作把成批 Gaussians 载入 shared memory，逐像素 front-to-back 遍历列表累积颜色与 α，某像素达到 α 饱和即停止该线程，整 tile 所有像素饱和则整个 tile 终止（E086）。反向传播不限制参与梯度的 primitive 数量，因此需要恢复 forward 中每像素的完整混合序列：复用已排序的 Gaussian 数组与 tile 范围，改为 back-to-front 遍历，每个点只存 forward 结束时的累计 α，再在反向遍历中除以该点自身的 α，得到梯度计算所需的中间不透明度（E087, E088）。为数值稳定，forward 与 backward 都跳过 α < 1/255 的 blending 更新并把 α 从上方 clamp 到 0.99（E259）；forward 中还会先计算若把某 Gaussian 计入后的累计不透明度，在它可能超过 0.9999 之前停止 front-to-back blending（E261）。

训练调度与实现。方法用 Python 与 PyTorch 实现，光栅化写成扩展前作的自定义 CUDA kernels，快速 Radix sort 使用 NVIDIA CUB 的排序例程，并以开源 SIBR 构建交互式 viewer 用于测量帧率（E114）。为稳定性，优化先做低分辨率 warm-up：从 4 倍下采样分辨率开始，在 250 与 500 iterations 后各上采样一次（E115）。SH 系数优化在角度信息缺失时可能给零阶分量（base 或 diffuse color）产生完全错误的值，因此先只优化 zero-order component，之后每 1000 iterations 引入一个 band，直到 4 bands 的 SH 全部出现（E116, E120）。训练完成后 renderer 支持对多种场景的实时导航（E050）。","sources":["E002","E007","E008","E009","E010","E013","E015","E018","E021","E022","E027","E028","E029","E030","E031","E033","E034","E035","E036","E038","E050","E055","E057","E058","E059","E060","E063","E064","E065","E066","E067","E068","E079","E081","E083","E085","E086","E087","E088","E114","E115","E116","E120","E203","E207","E231","E236","E237","E238","E239","E242","E259","E261"]}
message.reasoning_content:
Let me review the draft against the sources and produce a corrected JSON.

Key checks:

1. Task/input/output: input images + SfM calibrated cameras, sparse point cloud from SfM used for initialization. E007, E013. Output: 3D Gaussians, real-time rendering 1080p. E002, E011. "1080p" appears in E002 ("real-time rendering at SOTA quality for 1080p resolution on several previously published datasets"). OK.

"与需要 MVS 数据的点基方法不同，本方法只用 SfM 点即可取得高质量结果；在 NeRF-synthetic 数据集上甚至能从随机初始化开始（E007）" — E007 says "In contrast to most point-based solutions that require MVS data, we achieve high-quality results with only SfM points as input. Note that for the NeRF-synthetic dataset, our method achieves high quality even with random initialization." Fine.

2. Gaussian definition: E018: "Our Gaussians are defined by a full 3D covariance matrix Σ defined in world space [Zwicker et al. 2001a] centered at point (mean) μ". E021: G(x) = e^{-1/2 (x-μ)^T Σ^{-1} (x-μ)}. E022: multiplied by α in blending. E013 gives position (mean), covariance matrix, opacity α.

The draft's formula: "G(x) = exp(−1/2 (x−μ)^T Σ^{−1} (x−μ))" — from the block fragments E019 "1 T − 1", E020 "− ( x ) Σ ( x )", E021 "G ( x ) = e 2 (4)". So the exponent is −1/2 (x−μ)^T Σ^{−1} (x−μ). The draft writes it correctly. Good — but note the draft uses "exp(" while paper writes "e^{...}". Fine; I'd write it as in the paper style: G(x) = e^{−1/2 (x−μ)^T Σ^{−1} (x−μ)}. Keep it.

3. Projection: Σ' = J W Σ W^T J^T. E027: "Σ ′ = JW Σ W T J T (5)". Yes with primes. E028: J is the Jacobian of the affine approximation of the projective transformation. E029: skipping third row and column of Σ' gives 2×2 variance matrix with same structure as starting from planar points with normals. Draft fine.

Note: It's "variance matrix" — the draft says "2×2 variance matrix". Good.

4. Parameterization: Σ = R S S^T R^T (E033). Store s (3D vector for scaling) and quaternion q for rotation; normalize q. E034. Gradients explicitly derived (E035). M = RS, Σ = MM^T (E203). ∂Σ/∂M = 2M^T... E209: "d Σ T ∂M i,j pactly found by = 2 M ." Hmm, the fragmentary text: "∂Σ/∂M = 2(M^T ...)"? Actually it's ambiguous due to PDF fragmentation. The draft says "再把 Σ 写成 M = RS 的 MM^T 形式，再由 ∂Σ/∂M 以及 ∂M/∂s、∂M/∂q 经链式法则得到对 s 与 q 的导数（E035, E203, E209）". That's reasonably safe but the exact form of ∂Σ/∂M is unclear ("2M^T" per fragment). Better to say chain rule via M = RS and Σ = MM^T. I might keep it but avoid stating the exact derivative form. Instead: "由于 Σ 是对称矩阵，链式法则中 ∂Σ/∂M 这一共同部分可以先计算，再分别乘以 ∂M/∂s 与 ∂M/∂q". E207: "the shared first part is compactly found by..." So state the shared first part exists. That's supported.

5. Initialization & training objective: E038: positions p, α, covariance Σ, SH coefficients for color c. E058: initial covariance as isotropic Gaussian with axes equal to mean of distance to closest three points; exponential decay scheduling similar to Plenoxels, but for positions only. The draft says "位置采用类似 Plenoxels 的 exponential decay scheduling（E057, E058）" — E058 says "We use a standard exponential decay scheduling technique similar to Plenoxels, but for positions only." OK. Actually that sentence about scheduling is E058. Fine.

E057: sigmoid for α in [0-1) range, exponential activation for the scale of covariance. Draft says "covariance 的 scale 使用 exponential activation". OK.

Loss: L = (1−λ)L1 + λ L_D-SSIM, λ = 0.2. E059, E060. Note: "D-SSIM" — draft writes "L_D-SSIM". Fine.

Algorithm 1: E236-E240. Optimizer: Adam (E239) — draft says "经 Adam 更新". Good. Note the parameters M, S, C, A (positions, covariances, colors, opacities).

But careful: "优化由反复的渲染并与训练视图比较驱动" - E055 says successive iterations of rendering and comparing to training views. Good.

Also should mention: geometry may be incorrectly placed due to 3D-to-2D ambiguity, so optimization must be able to create, destroy, or move geometry (E055). Good to include.

6. Adaptive density control: E063: after warm-up, densify every 100 iterations, remove Gaussians with α < ε_α. Draft fine. Note it's "density over unit volume" concept mentioned.

E064: focus on under-reconstruction and over-reconstruction regions, both have large view-space positional gradients. E065: threshold τ_pos = 0.0002, average magnitude of view-space position gradients.

E066: clone small Gaussians in under-reconstructed regions — create copy of same size, move in direction of positional gradient. E067: split large Gaussians in regions with high variance into two, divide scale by φ = 1.6; initialize positions using original 3D Gaussian as PDF for sampling. E068: first case increases total volume and number; second conserves total volume but increases number. Floaters near cameras; set α close to zero every N = 3000 iterations.

E079: remove Gaussians that are very large in worldspace and those with big footprint in viewspace. Draft fine.

7. Rasterizer: E081 goals. E083: 16×16 tiles, cull against view frustum and each tile, keep Gaussians with 99% confidence interval intersecting view frustum, guard band for extreme positions. E085: instantiate per overlapping tiles, key combining view space depth and tile ID, single GPU Radix sort, no per-pixel ordering, blending approximate in some configurations, approximations negligible as splats approach pixel size.

Draft says "key 由 view space depth 与 tile ID 组合" — E242 (Appendix C) says lower 32 bits encode projected depth and higher bits the tile index. E085 says "assign each instance a key that combines view space depth and tile ID". OK.

E086: per-tile lists by first and last depth-sorted entry; one thread block per tile; collaboratively load; front-to-back accumulate color and α; stop when α saturation; tile terminates when all pixels saturated.

E087: no limit on number of blended primitives receiving gradient updates; backward pass recovers full sequence; traverse per-tile lists again, reuse sorted array and tile ranges, back-to-front.

E088: traversal starts from last point that affected any pixel in the tile; each pixel only starts overlap testing if depth ≤ depth of last point that contributed; accumulated opacity: each point stores final accumulated opacity in forward, divide by each point's α in back-to-front traversal to obtain coefficients.

Draft says "每个点只存 forward 结束时的累计 α，再在反向过程中除以该点自身的 α 得到梯度计算所需系数" — supported by E088.

Numerical stability: E259: skip blending updates with α < ε (ε chosen as 1/255) and clamp α with 0.99 from above. E261: before a Gaussian is included in forward rasterization pass, compute accumulated opacity if included and stop front-to-back blending before it can exceed 0.9999. Draft's rendering: "跳过 α < 1/255 的 blending 更新并把 α 从上方 clamp 到 0.99，且在 forward 中先计算包含某 Gaussian 后的累计不透明度，在超过 0.9999 前停止 front-to-back blending". Hmm — E261 says stop blending before it can exceed 0.9999. So it should be "在累计不透明度会超过 0.9999 之前停止". The draft says "在超过 0.9999 前停止" — acceptable but let me phrase more precisely: "若把该 Gaussian 计入会使累计不透明度超过 0.9999，则在计入它之前停止 front-to-back blending".

Also note E257: numerical stability discussion relates to backward pass reconstructing intermediate opacity by dividing accumulated opacity by each Gaussian's α, prone to instabilities (division by 0), addressed by skipping blending updates with α < ε and clamping. Draft attributes the skip/clamp appropriately. Fine.

8. Implementation: E114: Python, PyTorch, custom CUDA kernels extended from previous methods, NVIDIA CUB sorting routines for radix sort, interactive viewer using SIBR. E115: warm-up at 4× smaller resolution, upsample twice after 250 and 500 iterations. E120: SH: start with zero-order only, introduce one band every 1000 iterations until all 4 bands.

Draft includes these. Good.

E050: "Once trained, our renderer allows real-time navigation for a wide variety of scenes." Fine.

Now — reviewer corrections needed:

a) "1080p" claim: E002 says real-time rendering at SOTA quality for 1080p resolution on several previously published datasets. Draft says "可在 1080p 分辨率下实时渲染（E002, E011）". E011 says "provide the first real-time rendering with high quality for novel-view synthesis" — no 1080p. So 1080p is from E002. Fine as combined, but each sentence should cite. It's OK.

b) The draft says "该 Gaussian 在 blending 时再乘以 α（E018, E021, E022）" — E022: "This Gaussian is multiplied by α in our blending process." OK.

c) The draft's mention of "E038" for simultaneous optimization of p, α, Σ, SH — E038: "In addition to positions p, α, and covariance Σ, we also optimize SH coefficients representing color c of each Gaussian". Good.

d) The draft's gradient explanation: "先把 Σ 写成 M = RS 的 MM^T 形式，再由 ∂Σ/∂M 以及 ∂M/∂s、∂M/∂q 经链式法则得到对 s 与 q 的导数". E203 supports M = RS, Σ = MM^T. E209 fragment "compactly found by = 2 M" is garbled. I'll keep the description but note the shared first part is computed once because Σ is symmetric (E207). Avoid asserting exact "2M^T". Actually the fragment reads "d Σ T ∂M i,j ... pactly found by = 2 M" suggesting ∂Σ/∂M = 2M^T maybe. It's garbled — per instruction, formula unclear/PDF fragments must not be guessed. So I'll just say the chain rule goes through ∂Σ/∂M and ∂M/∂s, ∂M/∂q, without stating its exact form. Better to say "推导经由 M = RS 与 Σ = MM^T 分解，先得到对 M 的导数再分别对 s 与 q 求导". Hmm, that's basically the draft. Keep it but remove the "∂Σ/∂M" explicit notation? It's fine to mention ∂Σ/∂M as a chain-rule factor; the draft did mention. Actually to be safe I'll phrase: "由于 covariance matrix 及其梯度都是对称的，链式法则中共享的前一段可以一次性算出，再分别与 ∂M/∂s、∂M/∂q 相乘（E207, E203）". And for rotation, conversion from unit quaternion q with real part q_r and imaginary parts q_i, q_j, q_k to rotation matrix R is given (E211) and gradients for q components given (E221-E231). Could mention quaternion normalization gradient is straightforward (E231). Keep brief.

e) Also equation numbering: (4) for Gaussian, (5) for projection, (6) for Σ = RSS^T R^T, (7) for loss. Could mention numbers. The draft doesn't. Optional; I can add numbers to help. Fine to include since they're in the excerpts (E021 has (4), E027 has (5), E033 has (6), E059 has (7), E216 has (10), E188 (8), E191 (9)). Keep some.

f) Any mentioned item not supported? "无结构、显式的 3D Gaussians" — E015 says "unstructured and explicit". E007 "reasonably compact, unstructured, and precise representation". OK.

g) "1-5 million Gaussians for all scenes tested" (E007) — not included; okay either way. Could add but not necessary. Actually could be good for method completeness (output size). The instruction says avoid result side branches, but representation compactness is part of the method. I'll skip or briefly mention. Keep soft word count.

h) Check "每 100 iterations 进行一次 densify" — E063: "we densify every 100 iterations and remove any Gaussians that are essentially transparent". Good.

i) The draft says "warm-up 之后" — E063 says "After optimization warm-up (see Sec. 7.1)". Good.

j) Potential issue: draft writes "τ_pos = 0.0002" for view-space position gradient threshold. E065 confirms.

k) Draft: "scale 除以实验确定的 φ = 1.6" — E067 confirms.

l) "克隆：复制一个同尺寸副本并沿位置梯度方向移动" — E066 confirms.

m) The 3000 iteration α reset: E068: "set the α value close to zero every N = 3000 iterations". Good.

n) Should we mention "Guard band"? OK.

o) One thing: E083 also mentions culling "against the view frustum and each tile" — draft mentions tile instantiation later. Fine.

p) Draft says "先做视锥体裁剪" — cull Gaussians against view frustum and each tile. Fine.

Everything seems in good shape. Some refinements:

- Term explanations first occurrence: "3D Gaussians（每个都定义在中心 μ 处的各向异性三维高斯）". Draft explains covariance and α. Fine.

- Should explain why Σ parameterization with R and S can express the covariance: "因为 covariance matrix 相当于描述一个椭球的构型" (E031: "The covariance matrix Σ of a 3D Gaussian is analogous to describing the configuration of an ellipsoid"). The draft mentions "各向异性椭球" earlier. Let me add: R 与 S 之所以等价表达 Σ，是因为 3D Gaussian 的 covariance matrix 相当于描述椭球的构型，scaling 决定椭球轴长，rotation 决定其朝向 (E031). Actually E031 says Σ is analogous to describing the configuration of an ellipsoid; given scaling matrix S and rotation matrix R, we can find Σ. Good — add one clause.

- Explain why α sigmoid in [0-1): constrain. Already.

- Explain spherical harmonics: "表示颜色 c 的 spherical harmonics (SH) 系数" — E013: the directional appearance component (color) represented via SH. Explain that SH coefficients represent view-dependent appearance/directional color. Add: SH 系数需要能够表达随视角变化的方向性外观 (E038, E013).

- Also mention: for synthetic Blender dataset random initialization and pruning to 6-10K — that's result/section 7.2, skip (evaluation).

Word count: current draft is decent length — let's estimate. The draft is quite long, probably ~1400 Chinese chars. Our revision should stay 900-1600.

Now, sections: I should also verify claims about "E002" for 1080p etc.

Let me also double-check the covariance projection equation's transpose order: Σ' = J W Σ W^T J^T. E027: "Σ = JW Σ W J" with fragments T T at E026 "′ T T" and E027 "Σ = JW Σ W J (5)". So Σ' = J W Σ W^T J^T. Draft wrote "J W Σ W^T J^T". Correct.

Loss: L = (1−λ)L1 + λ L_D-SSIM (E059). Good.

One more: E056: SGD techniques, GPU-accelerated frameworks, custom CUDA kernels. Draft mentions Algorithm 1 uses Adam (E239). Might mention optimization uses SGD with Adam. Fine.

Also E049/E048: "During optimization we use our fast tile-based renderer" — fine.

Now about the instruction to "先判断论文的核心贡献类型" — model/algorithm paper. We can add a brief opening sentence framing contributions: anisotropic 3D Gaussians as representation, optimization with adaptive density control, fast differentiable rasterizer (E008, E009, E010). That's good framing and supported.

Let me write the final text, with citations placed at ends of sentences, at most 1-2 aliases per sentence, no repetition within a sentence.

Structure:

1. 任务与核心贡献 (E007, E013, E002, E008, E009, E010)
2. 场景表示与 why Gaussian (E015, E018, E021, E022, E013)
3. 投影 (E027, E028, E029)
4. 优化参数化 (E030, E031, E033, E034, E036)
5. 梯度 (E035, E203, E207, E231, E211)
6. 优化流程与损失 (E055, E058, E057, E059, E060, E056, E236, E238, E239)
7. 自适应密度控制 (E063, E064, E065, E066, E067, E068, E079)
8. rasterizer (E081, E082, E083, E085, E086, E087, E088, E259, E261, E242)
9. 实现与调度 (E114, E115, E120, E050)
